usedFor: Todoist holds the tasks, and Bria AI makes pictures from a prompt through “Generate Image”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Generate Image” in Bria AI
bestTemplate.why: The task text can serve as the prompt, and the action creates images from it.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist is polling, so images appear after a scheduled check.
